Adobe Stock Skills v2026 - AI stock research tool 2026

An integrated Adobe Stock discovery suite tailored for Claude Code, built to uncover underserved marketplace sectors, analyze search query difficulty, and spin up actionable image and video generation prompts.

Download Latest Build

Download

Overview

Adobe Stock Skills brings deep marketplace intelligence into the Claude Code ecosystem. Tailored specifically for digital creators, photographers, and motion designers, this utility eliminates guesswork by revealing search volume saturated with low-density competition across photos, transparent PNGs, and stock footage.

By unifying a browser-based visualization portal, an MCP server protocol, and custom Claude Code slash interactions, the system delivers a continuous analytical pipeline. Creators can evaluate query difficulty, brainstorm creative concepts, and archive prospective project data without fragmenting their attention across multiple disparate utilities.

Core Capabilities

  • Evaluates query difficulty and saturation indicators on Adobe Stock
  • Assesses niche viability to spotlight high-potential, low-saturation topics
  • Formulates tailored visual generation prompts for static imagery
  • Crafts descriptive creative prompts for motion and video assets
  • Accommodates dedicated asset pipelines for photographs, transparent PNG elements, and video clips
  • Features a centralized visual UI to inspect metrics and trends
  • Retains research histories locally for future production cycles
  • Plugs natively into Claude Code via slash commands
  • Bundles an integrated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for tool chaining

Getting Started

Fetch the source repository and navigate to the root directory:

git clone https://github.com/u1483yzabc/adobe-stock-skills-2026.git
cd adobe-stock-skills

Configure your Claude Code workspace according to your local configuration parameters, then launch the client dashboard or supporting services directly from the workspace.

For packaged releases, decompress the downloaded archive and run the executable entry point included in the directory.

Operational Walkthrough

A standard analytical session flows as follows:

  1. Fire up the local client dashboard or initialize the MCP connector.
  2. Provide a seed theme or target Adobe Stock query.
  3. Review competition analytics along with automated niche health scores.
  4. Synthesize context-aware prompt descriptions for graphic or cinematic projects.
  5. Store relevant discoveries to local history for production tracking.

For an uninterrupted terminal experience, execute supported slash commands directly within Claude Code based on your environment configurations.

Configuration Settings

Operational profiles are maintained inside your active workspace configuration, shared among the web interface, the Claude Code bridge, and the MCP endpoint.

Sample json structure:

{
  "platform": "Claude Code",
  "researchTypes": ["photo", "PNG", "video"],
  "saveResults": true,
  "dashboard": true
}

Tune these directives to align with your content focus, active API connectors, and prompt synthesis preferences.

System Prerequisites

  • Configured Claude Code runtime
  • Compatible execution environment capable of running the MCP service and local UI
  • Unrestricted filesystem access to the project directory
  • Available local disk volume to preserve output databases and logs
  • Modern web browser for rendering the graphical frontend

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the recommended procedure for applying updates?
Pull down the newest commits from the Git tree or retrieve the most recent packaged distribution from the link provided above.

How do I adjust operational parameters?
Modify the dedicated workspace JSON configuration file wired to your Claude Code workspace, MCP host, or interface server.

Which asset formats are covered?
The utility supports data discovery, demand scoring, and creative prompt production across standard photography, transparent PNGs, and footage categories.

What steps resolve a dashboard launch failure?
Confirm that runtime dependencies match prerequisites, verify execution from the intended project folder, and ensure the local listening environment is unrestricted.

Is my discovery history retained across sessions?
Yes, all gathered niche metrics and generated concept prompts can be written to disk for long-term reference.
